stated: The Conservative Party will cut the Covid court backlog by keeping open Nightingale courtrooms, funding sitting days, investing in court maintenance, and continuing to digitise court processes and expand remote hearings.

source.quote: We will cut the Covid court backlog by keeping open Nightingale courtrooms, funding sitting days and investing in court maintenance. And we will continue to digitise court processes and expand the use of remote hearings.

bearing_set.reason: Court backlogs directly affect charge/conviction times, victims' access to justice, and the functioning of the justice system — all core O5 indicators.

membership_note: Single-target policy aimed squarely at the court backlog — a named O5 indicator. The fiscal cost of court maintenance and sitting days is real but modest in public-expenditure terms and not of a scale to materially move the O12 debt-path indicator. No surveillance/coercion dimension triggers O10; no discrimination/due-process gap (as opposed to throughput) triggers O9.
